accessories.name: Explorer’s Belt
accessories.description: You gain a +4 bonus to your Initiative modifier.

accessories.name: Gloves, Elegant
accessories.description: You are immune to dazed.

accessories.name: Gloves, Rough
accessories.description: You are immune to weak.

accessories.name: Gloves, Silky
accessories.description: You are immune to slow.

accessories.name: Gloves, Warm
accessories.description: You are immune to shaken.

accessories.name: Rookie’s Boots
accessories.description: When you roll a fumble, if you have less than 10 Experience Points, you may gain 1 Experience Point.

accessories.name: Han’nya Mask
accessories.description: All damage you deal to shaken creatures ignores Resistances.

accessories.name: Pendant, Amber
accessories.description: You gain Resistance to earth damage.

accessories.name: Pendant, Amethyst
accessories.description: You gain Resistance to dark damage.

accessories.name: Pendant, Diamond
accessories.description: You gain Resistance to light damage.

accessories.name: Pendant, Emerald
accessories.description: You gain Resistance to poison damage.

accessories.name: Pendant, Opal
accessories.description: You gain Resistance to air damage.

accessories.name: Pendant, Ruby
accessories.description: You gain Resistance to fire damage.

accessories.name: Pendant, Sapphire
accessories.description: You gain Resistance to ice damage.

accessories.name: Pendant, Topaz
accessories.description: You gain Resistance to bolt damage.

accessories.name: Ring of Sorcery
accessories.description: You gain a +1 bonus to Magic Defense.

accessories.name: Wanderer’s Boots
accessories.description: When your group makes a discovery while traveling, you may gain 1 Fabula Point.

accessories.name: Crested Helm
accessories.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Accuracy Checks.

accessories.name: Gloves, Crimson
accessories.description: When you perform an attack with multi, you gain a +2 bonus to your Accuracy Check.

accessories.name: Pointy Yellow Hat
accessories.description: You gain a +1 bonus to your Magic Checks.

accessories.name: Ring of the Lion
accessories.description: You gain a +2 bonus to Opposed Checks that rely on Willpower.

accessories.name: Ring of the Owl
accessories.description: You gain a +2 bonus to Opposed Checks that rely on Insight.

accessories.name: Ring of the Pupil
accessories.description: As long as you have at least two Bonds of admiration, you gain a +1 bonus to both your Defense and Magic Defense.

accessories.name: Ring of Tales
accessories.description: When you roll a critical success, you may spend that opportunity to gain 1 Fabula Point.

accessories.name: Gloves, Multigroa Skin
accessories.description: You are immune to all status effects.

accessories.name: Ring of Onions
accessories.description: As long as you have this accessory equipped, increase your maximum Hit Points and maximum Mind Points by 2 for each different Class you have.

accessories.name: Ring of Frost
accessories.description: You gain Absorption to ice damage and Vulnerability to fire damage.

accessories.name: Ring of Magma
accessories.description: You gain Absorption to fire damage and Vulnerability to ice damage.

accessories.name: Ring of the Egg
accessories.description: When reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may instead choose to resist with exactly 1 Hit Point. If you do, this effect cannot be used until after you rest.

accessories.name: Ring of Denial
accessories.description: When you cast the Dispel spell, its MP cost becomes “10 × T” and its target becomes “Up to three creatures”.

accessories.name: Ring of the Occultist
accessories.description: Spells you cast with a target of “Up to three creatures” instead have a target of “Up to four creatures” (you must still spend additional Mind Points for the fourth target).

accessories.name: Ivory Ring
accessories.description: When your Faithful Companion loses Hit Points, you may choose to lose an equal amount of Hit Points in their stead.

accessories.name: Magic Palette
accessories.description: When you deal damage to a creature bearing one of your symbols, that damage ignores Resistances.

accessories.name: Tactician’s Diadem
accessories.description: When an ally takes their turn immediately after yours in the same round of conflict (such as due to Crushing Chariot, Ouroboros Dance, or Stolen Time), that ally recovers 5 Mind Points at the start of that turn.

accessories.name: Alchemist’s Bag
accessories.description: When you create a potion with the Gadgets (Alchemy) Skill, you may roll an additional d20.

accessories.name: Sorcerer’s Pendant
accessories.description: If you have acquired the Cheap Shot Skill, its extra damage also applies to any offensive spells (🗲) you cast that only target one creature, so long as that creature is suffering from at least one status effect.

accessories.name: Dancing Ribbon
accessories.description: While equipped with this accessory, your Dexterity is increased by one die size (up to a maximum of d12).

accessories.name: Watering Can
accessories.description: When you perform a water invocation, you may fill 1 section of the Growth Clock of a Player Character you can see.

accessories.name: Spicy Powder
accessories.description: When you deal damage using a delicacy or potion, you may change its type to fire. This effect may change the damage type dealt by the Expiration Date Skill.

accessories.name: Dandelion Obi
accessories.description: When you perform an air invocation, you may recover from a single status effect of your choice.

accessories.name: Clockwork Heart
accessories.description: You are Resistant to bolt and fire damage. If you enter Crisis, the effect of this accessory ceases until your next rest.

accessories.name: Needlefrog Mantle
accessories.description: When you deal poison damage to one or more creatures during a conflict, each of those creatures who loses Hit Points this way cannot recover Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

accessories.name: Handmade Scarf
accessories.description: When you gain one or more Trade Points via the Real Treasure Skill, you also gain 1 Fabula Point.

accessories.name: Fallen Leaf Amulet
accessories.description: When you use the Tree of Life Skill, if you are in Crisis and choose an ally you can see who is in Crisis, you and that ally both benefit from the Hit Point recovery granted by the Skill.

accessories.name: Eccentric’s Cookbook
accessories.description: Once per rest, you may choose a single combination of two tastes whose effect you already discovered. If you do, roll again to determine the effect of the combination, replacing the previous effect.

accessories.name: Spare Magazine
accessories.description: Once per scene, after rolling an Accuracy Check with a Firearm, you may reroll one of the dice for that Check.

accessories.name: Flashbang Grenades
accessories.description: When you deal damage to a creature using an elemental shard, that creature also suffers dazed.

accessories.name: Gas Mask
accessories.description: You gain Resistance to poison damage and are immune to poisoned.

accessories.name: Maverick Helmet
accessories.description: At the start of your turn during a conflict, if you are in Crisis and driving your personal vehicle, you may recover from a single status effect of your choice.

accessories.name: Ego Mask
accessories.description: After summoning an Arcanum on your turn during a conflict, you may perform a free attack with a weapon you have equipped. If you do, treat your High Roll as 0 when calculating damage dealt by this attack and you cannot willingly dismiss your Arcanum during this turn.

accessories.name: Medikit
accessories.description: When you cause one or more creatures to recover Hit Points with a potion or spell, if at least one of those creatures is in Crisis, each of them recovers 5 additional Hit Points.

accessories.name: Portable Assembler
accessories.description: Once per scene, when you have to pay an Inventory Point cost, you may halve that cost instead.

accessories.name: Omnidex
accessories.description: When you perform a Check to examine an NPC’s profile, treat any Result of 12 or lower as being 13, unless it is a fumble.
